test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

The national anthem is sung at the beginning of every match.

options.text: The national anthem sings at the beginning of every match.
People sing the national anthem at the beginning of every match.
They are singing the national anthem at the beginning of every match.
The national anthem has been sung at the beginning of every match.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. People sing the national anthem at the beginning of every match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice** in the present simple tense: *"The national anthem is sung at the beginning of every match."*
 
• To convert it into the **active voice**, the subject must be changed to a doer of the action (in this case, "People").
 
• The structure for active voice in present simple tense is: **Subject + base verb + object.**
 
• Thus, the correct active voice sentence is: *"People sing the national anthem at the beginning of every match."*

Correct sentence: *People sing the national anthem at the beginning of every match*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Difference between Active and Passive Voice:**
 
 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action (e.g., "People sing the anthem").
 
• **Passive Voice:** The subject receives the action (e.g., "The anthem is sung by people").
 
 
 
• **When to Use Active Voice:**
 
 
• To emphasize the doer of the action.
 
• To make sentences more direct and concise.
